annotations.title: Convert office documents to PDF with LibreOffice

description:
Convert an office document up to 4 MB to a PDF with LibreOffice (Gotenberg).

Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument and the other formats LibreOffice
opens. Pass the file as base64 in `content_base64`, or as a download link in
`file`, and its name in `filename`: the extension tells LibreOffice the
format. Returns `{"download_url": "<link>", "size_bytes": <PDF size>,
"expires_in_minutes": 60}`: give the user the `download_url`. Requires
an API key.

Credits: 1 per call.

content_base64.description: The file, base64-encoded. Up to 4 MB before encoding.

file.description: The file as a download link, instead of `content_base64`. In ChatGPT, pass the user's uploaded file here. Other clients can set `download_url` to a public https URL.

download_url.description: A public https URL of the file.

file_id.description: An identifier for the file. ChatGPT sets it; other clients may pass any label, such as the file name.

filename.description: The file name with its extension (.docx, .doc, .odt, .xlsx, .pptx, .rtf, …). LibreOffice reads the file by its extension.

name: office_to_pdf
title: Convert office documents to PDF with LibreOffice
